'''Julio''' was an object<ref name="RF" /> located in the [[Marcol sector/Legends|Marcol sector]] of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> By [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> Julio was known for its [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]].<ref name="RF" />

==Behind the scenes==
Julio was first mentioned<ref name="RF" /> in the novel ''[[Rebel Force: Trapped]]'', which was written by [[Alex Wheeler]] and released in [[2010]].<ref name="ERC" /> Later, the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the [[Julio system/Legends|Julio star system]], and thereby Julio itself, in grid square L-8.<ref name="EAOC" />

==Appearances==
*''[[Rebel Force: Trapped]]'' {{1stm}}
